description: Generate a static PIX copia-e-cola (BR Code) from a PIX key (CPF, CNPJ, phone with +55, e-mail or random key), with optional amount in BRL, receiver name, city, reference and message, following the Central Bank of Brazil standard. Self-checked; nothing is stored. Price: $0.005.

amount.description: Amount in BRL, up to 2 decimals (e.g. 25.00).

key.description: PIX key: CPF, CNPJ, phone with +55, e-mail or random key (EVP).

txid.description: Reference, letters and digits, up to 25.

name: generate_pix_code
